Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + suggested next step

Hi Elena — great to speak earlier. Quick recap from today’s call and proposed next step: 

What we heard
- You’re evaluating inference options for Orbit’s storefront search ranking and product description generation (primary goal: reduce latency for personalized queries while keeping token cost predictable).
- Important constraints: PCI-adjacent data handling, compliance review with security team, and a pilot window aligned to the Q4 roadmap (target start late Oct).

What Redwood can do (short)
- Dedicated serving with predictable throughput and prefix caching to cut per-token cost for repeated queries.
- Private deployment option for an isolated control plane if security team requires it.

Suggested next step
- I can put together a 2-week pilot plan (scope, success metrics, resource needs) and a short TCO sketch. Would a 30-min sync next week work to review?

Attached: discovery-recap-20260901.pdf — one-pager + proposed pilot outline.

If you’d prefer, I can instead send a one-slide pilot summary for your procurement team.

Thanks,
